title: Free bar, uniform heating
description: Steel bar 100 x 20 x 10 mm, every face at 120 °C, stress-free at 20 °C (dT = 100 K). The faces x = 0, y = 0 and z = 0 are sliding supports: statically determinate, so the bar expands freely.

quantities.label: Free thermal elongation
quantities.citation: Gere & Timoshenko, Mechanics of Materials (SI ed.), Ch. 2, sec. 2.5 Thermal Effects (free thermal expansion)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Statically determinate supports leave the expansion free: exact elongation, zero stress.

quantities.label: Peak von Mises stress (zero in theory; error relative to E alpha dT, the stress of a fully clamped bar)
quantities.citation: Gere & Timoshenko, Mechanics of Materials (SI ed.), Ch. 2, sec. 2.5 Thermal Effects (free thermal expansion)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Statically determinate supports leave the expansion free: exact elongation, zero stress.
